title: BTS Opens Three-Night Lima Run at Estadio San Marcos
detail: October 7, 2026 — BTS played the first of three sold-out ARIRANG World Tour shows in Lima, their first-ever Peru concert. The set opened with 'Hooligan' and included 'FYA', 'Merry Go Round', 'Body to Body', 'Fire', 'Not Today' and 'Normal'. The members addressed the crowd in Spanish, and 'Peru is key' drew the loudest reaction. No attendance figure was reported. Shows follow on Oct 9 and 10.

media.caption: BTS performs the first of three Lima shows.
